Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_TradeEnabled_toolt: Lets players trade Life With Style pieces with each other in the wardrobe window.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetsEnabled_toolti: A pet in the wardrobe's Pet box comes out and follows its owner. Off: no pet comes out (they stay in the wardrobes).
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetCommands_toolti: Follow, Stay, Come here and Speak. Off: pets only follow.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetFeeding_tooltip: Owners can feed their pet food they carry.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetHunger_tooltip: A pet gets hungry over time; a starving pet ignores orders until fed. It never dies or leaves.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetHungerHours_too: In-game hours a pet takes to go from full to starving.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetSounds_tooltip: Barks, whines and eating sounds. Pets never draw zombies.
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_PetTeleportDistanc: A following pet farther than this comes straight to its owner (a staying pet: twice this).
Sandbox_LifeWithStyle_TradeMaxDistance_t: How close two players must be to trade. 0 = anywhere on the server.
